description: Canonical schedulable resource shared across Tempo.Blazor components. Use it for rooms, equipment, teams, people-like capacity, or other resources that should not be modeled as users.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable resource identifier within the source and tenant scope.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Display name shown in user-facing UI.

members.name: ResourceType
members.description: Optional resource type, for example person, team, room, or equipment.

members.name: Color
members.description: Optional color token or sanitized CSS color used for resource labels and timelines.

members.name: GroupId
members.description: Optional group identifier for nested grouping.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional provider/source discriminator for applications with multiple resource sources.

members.name: TenantId
members.description: Optional tenant, workspace, or application scope identifier.

members.name: ToRef
members.description: Creates a lightweight reference snapshot from this resource.

members.name: FromRef
members.description: Creates a full resource model from a lightweight reference snapshot.
